name: MyGo App
purpose: Capture and recover private offline desktop notes with a web frontend
audience: Mac users keeping local working notes
differentiators: Offline note editing with a reversible owner-controlled backup
acceptance: Launch the actual packaged macOS app and use its visible web frontend to create and edit a note, then restart and recover the saved text
Export notes, remove local data and restore the same notes through the desktop UI; record actual window screenshots
constraints: Use go.mod, mygo.config.ts and a real frontend package.json with its committed dependency lock; this paired profile illustrates an existing Bun frontend with a real build script, not a requirement to migrate package managers
Pin github.com/egoist/mygo v0.3.0 and its cmd/mygo tool directive in go.mod; use Go 1.27.1
Set the MyGo app name to MyGo App and version to 0.1.0; match darwin/arm64 output paths in the paired profile

Prepare generated frontend bindings and lockfiles before verification; implement cmd/acceptance to launch and drive the real desktop app and fail on UI assertion errors, not merely run browser or headless tests
No accounts, network dependency, Developer ID, notarization, upload or publishing
